reasoning: The icon combines an alarm clock silhouette with a central pause symbol, clearly communicating pausing a timer, snoozing an alarm, or temporarily suspending a recurring schedule or subscription. While literal UI timer controls aren't tasks, putting recurring deliveries, memberships, alarms, or scheduled jobs on hold is a common real-world task family.
